posts.title: SteamLite 26.11.6 is out - optimised animations and smooth scrolling
posts.summary: SteamLite 26.11.6 is out. It is a small update about how SteamLite moves: the animations are lighter and smoother, and the mouse wheel now scrolls smoothly.

posts.summary: SteamLite 26.11.5 is a feature update with a completely reworked News page, and a Roadmap so you can see what we are working on.

posts.title: The Animation initiative is on-board
posts.summary: The Animation initiative is on-board: we will work to fix animations and optimize current animations to run better while your PC is running games.

posts.title: The 'GTA 6' theme will return
posts.summary: The 'GTA 6' theme will return when the game releases for the PC platform, or when it's available on Steam.

posts.title: SteamLite 10.1.5 Released - The Non-Steam page
posts.summary: SteamLite 10.1.5 is out. A new Non-Steam page spots any game running on your PC that is not from Steam and finds pictures for it, with a temporary game page you can add to your library. Games from Rockstar, Epic, GOG…

posts.title: SteamLite 10.1.4 Released - A better About page and the verified tick
posts.summary: SteamLite 10.1.4 is out. The About page has links to Discord, the website and Instagram and a card to add the creator as a friend, verified players get a blue tick, and switching chats now fades in. It also fixes chats…

posts.title: SteamLite 10.1.3 Released - Download themes, collections and offline mode
posts.summary: SteamLite 10.1.3 is out. Themes are now downloaded when you want them, with a screenshot of each, collections are back, and there is a new offline mode with a Disconnect button in Settings > Online.

posts.title: SteamLite 10.1.2 Released - A fix for freezing when adding games
posts.summary: SteamLite 10.1.2 is out. It fixes SteamLite freezing when you added games from the Start menu. If you installed 10.1.0 or 10.1.1, please update.

posts.title: SteamLite 10.1.1 Released - A fix for SteamLite stopping
posts.summary: SteamLite 10.1.1 is out. It fixes SteamLite stopping after a minute or two, when nothing loaded and the minimise and close buttons did not work. If you installed 10.1.0, please update.

posts.summary: SteamLite 10.0.2 is out. Achievement pictures load again, and game page tabs, the Library filters and other choices now have a highlight that glides between them. Buttons spring when pressed and page sections rise in…

posts.title: SteamLite 10.0.1 Released - Fixes and polish
posts.summary: SteamLite 10.0.1 is out. It makes page changes smoother, removes a clipped glow under the selected filter chips and game tabs, fixes spacing in Settings, and fixes a few small bugs.

posts.title: SteamLite 10.0.0 Released - A new engine and a new interface

posts.title: SteamLite 9.4.1 Released - Profile changes sync both ways
posts.summary: Edit your profile look on your phone or on the PC: banner, frame, title, accent colour, tagline and showcase now stay the same in both. A banner picture you pick on the phone is brought over to the PC as well.

posts.title: SteamLite 9.4.0 Released - Control your PC from your phone
posts.summary: SteamLite Mobile can now show what you are playing on your PC and, if you turn on the new switch in Settings, Privacy, lock it, put it to sleep or close the game. Pairs with SteamLite Mobile 1.4.0.

posts.title: SteamLite 9.3.2 Released - Streak sync
posts.summary: Your daily play streak now stays in step between your PC and SteamLite Mobile: launching a game updates the phone straight away, and a message sent from the phone counts as a play day on the PC.

posts.title: SteamLite 9.3.1 Released - Keep your streak from your phone
posts.summary: Away from your PC? Sending a message in SteamLite Mobile now counts as a play day, so your streak keeps going. Pairs with SteamLite Mobile 1.2.1.

posts.title: SteamLite 9.3.0 Released - Your profile look follows you
posts.summary: The look you give your profile (banner, avatar frame, title, accent colour, tagline and showcase) is now shared with your friends and with SteamLite Mobile. Open a friend's profile on the PC to see theirs too. Pairs…

posts.title: SteamLite 9.2.5 Released - Start games from your phone
posts.summary: A small update for SteamLite Mobile: turn on "Let my phone launch games" in Settings > More settings > Privacy and the Play on my PC button on a game page in the phone app starts that game on this computer.

posts.title: SteamLite 9.2.4 Released - Photos, voice messages and more
